title: AMANI House
summary: A home for performance at 2,400m in the town that produced more distance running champions than anywhere on earth.
body:
Iten, Kenya sits at 2,400m and is known as the Home of Champions for its long history of producing the best distance runners in the world. AMANI House is where the project plants the flag of cycling — a space dedicated to performance and excellence.

title: Black Mamba Development Squad
eyebrow: U23 Squad · Based at AMANI House
summary: The U23 team — the project's down payment on the next generation of East African champions.
body:
Based at AMANI House, the Black Mamba Development Squad is AMANI's U23 team. These women and men are given the physical and intellectual development they need to become the next generation of champions.
